# Blue Haven Windows

> Official website of Blue Haven Windows, a family-owned residential replacement window and window installation business serving Franklin and nearby Middle Tennessee communities.

## Business and contact information

- Name: Blue Haven Windows
- Address: 3001 Knoll Top Ln Apt 2051, Franklin, TN 37067
- Telephone: +1-615-987-0593 (615-987-0593)
- Email: info@bluehavenview.com
- Website: https://bluehavenview.com/
- Services: residential replacement windows, window installation, energy-efficient windows, custom window styles, and warranty information.
- Service area: Franklin, Brentwood, Nashville, Clarksville, Columbia, Murfreesboro, Nolensville, Spring Hill, Thompson's Station, and nearby Middle Tennessee communities.
- Estimates: call the business or use the estimate form on the [window replacement page](https://bluehavenview.com/window-replacement.html#page-contact).

## Using this directory

This is a directory of official public information, last reviewed November 4, 2026. The linked pages are the sources for service details, educational content, project examples, and warranty terms. Contact the business to confirm current pricing, offers, availability, and project-specific recommendations. The address identifies the business; this directory does not establish showroom hours or walk-in availability.
